text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The time Fine Motion has left to spend in Japan
is running short.
Tick by tick, the clock approaches the end—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet, that is precisely why. I will not waste any time.
I want to give her more memories, more experiences,
even if it's just a little more!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The only ramen shop I haven't been to isâ
here! ...Though it might be tough to get in.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
“But... the hours are irregular, and it seems like
they're only open until noon. Plus, it's so popular
that they sell out super early all the time...!”
choice_data_list: No, let's do our best to eat it! Time for a strategy!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
Are you prepared...?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Next stop! "Ramen: Hiruandon"!
Today's the day we go wait in line--!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even the shops with irregular hours are definitely open today.
Based on that intel, I've secured transportation and even contingency routes for unforeseen emergencies...!
choice_data_list: (I'll definitely make this a wonderful memory...!)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Look, look at the number of bookmarks!
I was so excited, I spent forever
reading all the blog reports~!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
My recommendation is the house specialty, the soy sauce ramen!
They say the combination with their secret broth is exquisite!
Aah... I wonder what kind of broth it is?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Over there...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following her pointing finger, there was a discreetly hung
ramen shop sign. Despite its hard-to-spot location,
I could already see people starting to line up.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Phew, not many people in line yet!
Operation Wake-Up-Early was a success!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's go get in line right away!

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
"...Understood. I've got the picture.
No issues on my end. Please continue."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Captain. What was that transmission just now?

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
...No, it is a trivial matter.
Your Highness, please head over that way—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
No.
Would you mind answering, Commander?

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
...I am truly sorry.
Allow me to make my report.

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
—A Japan-Ireland cultural exchange event
was scheduled for today.
However, we are hearing that an operational issue has occurred.

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text: Visitors have expressed dissatisfaction, and they appear to be doing their utmost to calm the situation and get things back on track.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I see... So, what is the current situation?

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
...It seems to be running into some difficulties,
but the administrations of both countries are working diligently on it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She slowly turned her gaze toward me.
Gone was any trace of the young girl from moments ago.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Those eyes were firm and unwavering, eloquently expressing her mission.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, please let me go to the venue.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me. I have heard the situation.
Is there anything I might assist you with?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"—So, all I need to do is buy us some time, correct?
Please leave everything to me."

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
We have an announcement. Fine Motion-san has
rushed to the venue on short notice!
Let's hear a few words from her~!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hello, everyone!
Come on, let's talk a whole bunch today♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah, thank goodness.
Looks like the event can run normally now!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry for dragging you along.
But this is fine by me. In fact, this is what I want.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Between me and Ireland.
If you had to choose one—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Without hesitation, I'd choose Ireland.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ireland welcomed my family with open arms.
My father, my grandfather, my ancestors...
and I, too. It has nurtured us all with warmth.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: The people, the beautiful scenery—I only need close my eyes to see them anytime. My beloved cradle.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
—I want to answer that embrace, that love.
I want to spend a lifetime repaying that debt.
I want to dedicate all of my time to them.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That mission is my pride.
Because I love Ireland.
choice_data_list: (...What an unwavering look in her eyes.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—It makes no difference to her.
No matter how fun or lonely it is right now,
she will eventually return to her homeland in the end.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're right! As expected of you, Trainer.
This is more than enough already!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She will not waver.
She—this young girl—will forge herself into the foundation of the nation.
